Fits every filter: independent, scattered-site houses across Collin, Dallas, Denton, Johnson and Tarrant counties, 8 staff. Opener: your site promises 24-hour maintenance on the same 214-310-1630 line as the office; ask who takes those calls at 2 a.m. and what that does to the team's day. Unknown: whether after-hours calls are answered by staff or a service; owner direct line.
Unknown: Who answers the after-hours line; owner direct number; no published owner e-mail. Counties include Tarrant and Johnson, but HQ is Denton County (Lake Dallas) so kept in this region.

Software: appfolio
Doors: 700
Fit: Site says it manages single-family homes, apartments, duplexes, townhomes and condos; the AppFolio listings page (34 listings on 2026-10-02) is mostly single-family homes and townhomes/duplexes across Arlington, Fort Worth, Cleburne, Waxahachie, Burleson, Hurst, Mansfield and others. Opener: you already promise tenants a 24-hour on-call agent; who actually takes those 2 a.m. calls, and do they make it into AppFolio as work orders? Unknown: whether Herman still runs day-to-day, the operations contact, and a direct owner line.
Unknown: No named operations director; only the main office line found (also toll-free (800) 874-1801 at property-management.boswellrentals.com); the 700 count is the firm's own page, the mix includes apartments.
